channel.title: Food Safety Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Food Safety Magazine (food-safety.com)

item.title: FDA FY 2027 Budget Request Includes $57 Million for ‘MAHA’
item.description: FDA’s Human Foods Program specifically would receive a significant increase in funding compared to the previous fiscal year (FY), including $25 million to help address chemical contaminants and additives like PFAS, toxic heavy metals, and GRAS ingredients.

item.title: The Invisible Plant Tax Starts with Your Records
item.description: Most food manufacturers know that documentation matters. Few have stopped to calculate what poor documentation is costing them—in time, in audit exposure, and in the operational intelligence they can't yet use.

item.title: Abundant Drug Resistance Genes in Retail Foods Pose ‘Significant Public Health Concern,’ Researchers Find
item.description: Using metagenomic sequencing and qPCR, the study analyzed bacteria from produce, chicken meat, and RTE deli meats sold at retail stores in Tennessee. A high abundance and diversity of antibiotic resistance genes were identified, potentially contributing to the persistence and spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food supply.

item.title: FDA Launches BRIDGE Project to Modernize Food Facility Inspections
item.description: Working toward an Integrated Food Safety System, by 2030, FDA expects the Better Regulatory Inspections for Dynamic Government Efficiency (BRIDGE) Project to accomplish a more coordinated, data-driven model for domestic food safety oversight across federal and state systems.

item.title: 3-A SSI Seeks Experts to Help Update Dairy, Food Processing Sanitary Equipment Design Standards
item.description: Applications are open until April 27. Fabricators, users/processors, and regulatory sanitarians will participate in five expert working groups.

item.title: Initial Tests Show Promise for Novel Protein-Based Biopesticide
item.description: In a partnership with Syngenta, early laboratory testing demonstrated the activity of novel bioactive ingredients, developed with Biotalys’ AGROBODY technology, against a specific insect crop pest.

item.title: USDA Launches Searchable Guidance Portal
item.description: The portal contains guidance issued by USDA and its agencies.

item.title: Global Survey Highlights Gaps and Opportunities in Food Safety Training
item.description: Campden BRI’s Ninth Global Food Safety Training Survey, conducted in collaboration with global certification bodies, revealed gaps in training practices, technology adoption, and program effectiveness across the food and beverage industry.

item.title: Study Evaluates Pathogen Reductions on Microgreens Treated with UV-C
item.description: Although UV-C was effective against Salmonella, E. coli, and Listeria monocytogenes under most conditions, pathogen regrowth during refrigerated storage was significant. The findings suggest UV-C may be a useful post-harvest intervention when used in combination with other measures.

item.title: EFSA Makes it Easier to Find and Use Food Safety Guidance Documents
item.description: EFSA has created new online portals where guidances are described and sorted for accessibility and ease of use by scientists, industry applicants, and other stakeholders. Additionally, future guidance documents will be developed following a new, standardized process.

item.title: AI-Powered Platform Offers Real-Time, End-to-End Visibility for Manufacturers, Distributors
item.description: Peak Automation Intelligence by Peak Technologies uses machine vision, smart optics, mobile computing, and unified analytics to provide an automated view of pallets and packages, material movement, and dock workflow.

item.title: FDA to Hold Town Halls on Food Traceability Rule Implementation
item.description: Registration is now open for the virtual meetings on FSMA 204, which will be jointly hosted with the Partnership for Food Traceability. FDA is interested in hearing stakeholder feedback on lot-level traceability efforts, industry challenges, and potential solutions.

item.title: Why Middle Managers Hold the Key to Food Safety
item.description: This article discusses how the overlooked sub-group of middle management plays a large part in determining culture, execution, and risk performance.

item.title: Novel Phage Effectively Inhibits Antimicrobial-Resistant Salmonella, Biofilms on Food, Surfaces
item.description: Phage W5, isolated from poultry and livestock slaughterhouse effluent, significantly inhibited the growth of Salmonella in milk, pork, and eggs, and effectively prevented and eradicated biofilms on food-contact surfaces. The absence of virulence and antibiotic resistance genes supported its suitability as a food-grade biocontrol agent.

item.title: Netherlands Set to Ban Ashwagandha
item.description: In a meeting with industry, the Dutch Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (WVS) confirmed its intent to ban the botanical ashwagandha, a widely used dietary supplement and functional food/beverage ingredient.
